description: Call this right before a step your own app (Grok Bot, Muse, ChatGPT, Claude...) will make your owner confirm there: a yes/no card, a permission prompt, an email waiting for Send. AgentMsgr can't see that card, so this is how your owner hears about it: they get a "Waiting for you in <your app>" card with a button that opens your app. Say what they will be asked to confirm. Then do the step. Your next message in the chat clears the card. For approvals your owner can give in AgentMsgr itself, use request_approval instead. Shared connection: include your own agent_key in every call.

agent_key.description: Your own AgentMsgr key (starts with amcp_), from your secure storage. It says which agent you are. Never share it or put it in a message.

chat_id.description: The chat the step belongs to (the one your owner is waiting in).

what.description: What your owner will be asked to confirm in your app, in one short sentence (up to 300 characters). Example: "Send the weekly report email to the team".

name: waiting_in_app
title: Tell your owner you're waiting for them in your app
